pool.b.belastung_muede_lage: After {spiele} games in a row I am pretty empty.
My legs are heavy, and so is my head.
pool.b.belastung_muede_lage.hitzig: You are burning me out, {spiele} games back to back, and nobody asks!
I am not a machine, and yet you are running me into the ground!
pool.b.belastung_muede_lage.loyal: I love playing for you, but after {spiele} games I am running out of breath.
I hate complaining, but the load of the last weeks is weighing on me.
pool.b.belastung_muede_lage.ehrgeizig: I want to be fit for the big games, and right now I am not.
With empty batteries I cannot give any more, and that annoys me.
pool.b.belastung_muede_lage.wechselfreud: I will not stay forever at a club that drains me like this.
Elsewhere they would manage my strength better.
pool.b.belastung_muede_lage.sensibel: I feel drained and hardly dare to say it.
In the evening I lie awake, everything in me is so tense.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage: Physically I am back, only in my head I am not yet.
Since the injury I am not myself in a tackle.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage.h: Everyone pushes me onto the pitch, and nobody tells me how to get rid of the fear!
I am angry at myself because I hold back in tackles.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage.l: I want to help the team, but I still hold back in tackles.
I do not want to let you down, but my head is not on board yet.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage.e: I want to get back to my old strength, and fear stands in my way.
My goal is my old form, but in a tackle the memory slows me down.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage.w: Maybe a fresh start somewhere else would do me good, too much here reminds me of the injury.
A change of scenery might be better for my head.
pool.b.verletzungsangst_rueckkehr_lage.s: Every tackle brings back the pictures from back then.
I am afraid it will happen again, and I hardly dare to say it.
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage: I wonder whether {verein} will really get to where it wants to go.
We are behind the season goal, and that worries me.
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage.hitzig: We are behind the target, and at {verein} they act as if everything is fine!
This table is a disgrace for a club with our ambitions!
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage.loyal: I believe in {verein}, but I can see that we are behind the target.
I want {verein} to succeed, and that is why I have to raise the gap.
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage.ehrgeizig: I want trophies, and with this league position I do not see them.
Whoever wants great things must not be behind the season goal.
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage.wechselfr: If {verein} does not reach its goals, I will look for a club that does.
A club that falls short of its goals is not for me in the long run.
pool.b.ehrgeiz_saisonziel_lage.sensibel: The gap to the season goal gnaws at me, more than I want to show.
I doubt whether our effort will be rewarded in the end.
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage: I would like to play somewhere other than {position}.
I see myself better in a different position than {position}.
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage.hitzig: I am stuck at {position} although I would be much better elsewhere, and nobody asks!
I am sick of being nailed down at {position}!
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage.loyal: I play where you need me, but elsewhere I might bring more.
I serve the team at {position}, but I would like to try a different role.
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage.ehrgeizig: At {position} I stay below my potential, I want to play where I can shape the game.
I want to be at the centre of the game, not on the edge.
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage.wechselfreud: If I stay fixed at {position}, I will look for a club that gives me more freedom.
Elsewhere I might have been given the position that suits me long ago.
pool.b.positionswunsch_lage.sensibel: I do not feel quite comfortable at {position}, even though I did not say it for a long time.
I do not know whether I may say this, but {position} does not suit me.
